title: Affine torsion cohomological dimension bound
statement: For a field K with torsion cohomological dimension at most c, an affine finite-type K-scheme X of dimension at most d has Subsingleton (H^q(X,F)) for every torsion abelian etale sheaf F and every q with d + c < q.

proof.text: The wrapper applies the unchanged source-library theorem hasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE_of_isAffine to F,hF,q,hq. Its complete bridge proof installs the explicit structure morphism as X.Over, converts the field bound from Sheaf.H to ordinary derived-section cohomology using lem-weil-pbc-sheafH-ext-derived-comparison, and applies the fully proved Sheaf variant lem-sc-affine-torsion-cd-explicit-bound. That variant handles both the natural-number dimension comparison and the empty-scheme clause using the existing thm-sc-affine-torsion-cd. The source bridge converts the resulting vanishing back to Sheaf.H by the same comparison. No new sorry is introduced and all existing source signatures and public imports are unchanged.
